source.description: Repository structure, harness failure controls, capture wiring and generated shader consistency. No compiler, GPU or client.

architecture.description: Compiled production contracts for frame demand, four Draw adapters, capture ownership and model-normal consumers. No game or GPU timings.

gpu.description: Hidden-device image/state oracles for optional effect layers, capture orchestration and shadows. Requires a configured Windows GPU toolchain and client; does not establish game FPS.

packaging.description: Installer and package-tool regressions. A release additionally requires the production DLL build and tests/verify_packages.py on the actual produced archives.
